pages.title: Nutritional Debt
pages.text: When a food group drops to zero and stays there, you accumulate $(#e05252)Nutritional Debt$(). Debt represents a deeper deficit than a simple empty bar — your body has been running on empty for too long.

pages.title: Effects of Debt
pages.text:
While in debt for a group, the normal penalty is replaced by a $(#e05252)stronger debuff$(). The longer you remain in debt, the more severe the effect becomes.

Debt is shown as a negative indicator below the bar on the diet screen.

pages.title: Recovering from Debt
pages.text:
Refilling the bar does not immediately clear debt. You must keep the group $(bold)above zero for a sustained period$() before debt clears and the normal bar logic resumes.

The best cure is prevention — do not let bars sit empty.
